scenario: LSER.17.2 / LSER.10.9 — `direction` returns `Int?` (-1 / 0 / +1), and [LSER.17.2]'s Returns column is the static type of the companion read, so emitting `t.direction` into a `String?` slot is refused with DS_VALIDATE_TYPE_MISMATCH ([LEXP.7.3b]). The slot is `String?` so that [LNUL.5.1]'s non-null check cannot be what refuses it; the leaf mismatch is the only defect in the program. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_9_1_agg_type` types `direction` as `Int?`, and `dsc.validate.lexp_7_3b_kwarg_type` refuses the Int leaf against the String slot. A compiler that types the read `ty_unknown` skips the check and compiles this. The positive counterpart is compiler/LSER.17.2_direction_into_nullable_int_slot.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    d: String? mutable

series Sensor.state:
    direction sliding 10_s

rule r:
    Sensor t
->
    emit Out logical k: t.entity_id d: t.direction
